student_learning_goal: I can create and solve a balance puzzle using a variable.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can create and solve a balance puzzle using a variable.
header.character_watermark: Eddy and Vex together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.student_instructions: Pick a target. Write a balance puzzle using a variable.

image_placeholders.description: A puzzle box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. 'Target: ___'. 'My puzzle: ___ = ___ + ___' or similar. Header 'Part 1: My Balance Puzzle'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_PUZZLE: keywords (balance, puzzle) name the slots.

parts.student_instructions: Solve the puzzle. Show your work. Check.

image_placeholders.description: A solve box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. 'My answer: ___'. 'Check: ___'. Header 'Part 2: Solve and Check'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_SOLVE: keywords (solve) name the slots.

parts.answer_key: Open. Answer must verify the puzzle.

parts.student_instructions: Write 2 equivalent expressions for your target.

image_placeholders.description: Two equivalent slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. 'Equivalent 1: ___'. 'Equivalent 2: ___'. Header 'Part 3: Equivalent Expressions'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_EQUIV: keywords (equivalent) name the slots.

parts.answer_key: Open. Both must equal the target.

parts.student_instructions: What does your variable stand for?

image_placeholders.description: A reflection box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. 'My variable stands for: ___'. Header 'Part 4: Reflection'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_REFLECT: keywords (reflection) name the slot.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and solve their puzzle.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Watch for no-variable trap.
